description: The plot illustrates the relationship between activated parameters ratio and eval PPL for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 25 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and has a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A dashed red line represents "Transformer" and begins at approximately 11.6 at an activated parameter ratio of 100, remaining relatively stable at approximately 11.5 at a ratio of 25. A gray line with circular markers represents "Only MoHD FFN" and starts at approximately 11.6 at a ratio of 100, decreasing to approximately 12.2 at a ratio of 25. A dark blue line with circular markers represents "Only MoHD ATTN" and begins at approximately 12.2 at a ratio of 100, decreasing to approximately 13.2 at a ratio of 25. A light blue line with cross markers represents "MoHD ATTN + MLP" and starts at approximately 12.3 at a ratio of 100, decreasing to approximately 13.1 at a ratio of 25.
